# opentel-mcp

> Node.js OpenTelemetry instrumentation for Model Context Protocol
> (MCP) tool calls. Detects silent failures (CallToolResult.isError=true
> inside successful JSON-RPC 2.0 responses), attributes LLM cost
> and token usage per tool call, and groups identical failures
> with SHA-256-16 fingerprints.

**Author:** Thirumalaiboobathi B
**License:** MIT
**npm:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/opentel-mcp
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Thirumalaiboobathi/opentel-mcp
**Site:** https://opentel-mcp-site.pages.dev

## Concepts

- [Silent Failures](https://opentel-mcp-site.pages.dev/docs/silent-failures):
  Why MCP tools can fail while the JSON-RPC envelope reports success,
  and how opentel-mcp catches CallToolResult.isError=true.
- [Deep Failure Fingerprinting](https://opentel-mcp-site.pages.dev/docs/deep-fingerprinting):
  SHA-256-16 fingerprint that groups identical failures across noisy
  error messages. Cardinality-safe by construction.
- [Cost & Token Attribution](https://opentel-mcp-site.pages.dev/docs/cost-tracking):
  Automatic LLM cost and token attribution on MCP tool calls.
  Recognizes Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, Google, DeepSeek usage
  shapes. Budget guardrails as observability flags.

## Reference

- [API Reference](https://opentel-mcp-site.pages.dev/docs/api-reference): Real
  signatures for instrumentMcpServer, computeFingerprint,
  toSpanAttributes, ATTRIBUTE_KEYS, METRIC_SAFE_ATTRIBUTES,
  DEFAULT_CLASSIFIERS, DEFAULT_PRICING, defaultExtractor,
  calculateCost, and all exported types.
- [Metrics](https://opentel-mcp-site.pages.dev/docs/metrics): The six mcp.tool.*
  OpenTelemetry metrics (calls, errors, silent_failures, duration,
  tokens.total, cost.total) with SigNoz and Prometheus query examples.

## Guides

- [Getting Started](https://opentel-mcp-site.pages.dev/docs/getting-started):
  Install, initialize, first trace in under 60 seconds.
- [Migration](https://opentel-mcp-site.pages.dev/docs/migration): Moving from
  raw @opentelemetry/api instrumentation to opentel-mcp.
